applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term and job number of the failing change
Change effective date and effective dates of all later bound jobs
What was changed (driver, vehicle/VIN, coverage, named insured)
Exact error text, screenshot, user ID and time with time zone
Whether the job was approved / UW referral cleared; other policies affected?
title: OOS endorsement locked or stuck after approval or at rating
symptoms: Policy shows as locked; no further transaction possible
Approved OOS job never reaches Bound
OOS transactions stuck on several policies
cause: The job failed after approval or during quote/bind, leaving the period in Quoting, Binding or Draft with a workflow in error or a partly committed branch. Later jobs are blocked or preempted.
diagnosis: Check job status in Policy File > Transactions
Check the job's workflow in Server Tools > Workflow
Check for other open jobs (draft renewal, audit) on the policy
If several policies: check recent releases and batch runs; raise severity
resolution: Retry or resume the workflow if it is in error
If still unbound, withdraw and re-create the change
If a branch is partly committed, L3 runs a scripted data fix under change control (Cloud: approved Gosu; on-premise: SQL only with DBA sign-off)
workaround: None for the customer. Give the agent an expected time and keep the original request.
permanent_fix: Rollback handling in custom bind/approval code; monitor for jobs in Quoting/Binding over 1 hour.
escalation: PC L2 Application Support; L3 Policy Transactions for data fixes. Sev 2 if locked more than 1 business day; Sev 1 if more than 5 policies.
